```text
ID: vr-01
Title: Prepare the Verona project foundation

Status: DONE
Milestone: Project preparation without speculative application scaffolding.
Dependencies: None

Purpose:
Establish independent continuity, contributor rules, numbered tracking, an
engineering-book manuscript and the private GitHub Project before product design.

Tasks:
[x] Inspect the existing empty checkout and register the owner-designated base.
[x] Read the development manual and record Verona's development/book contract.
[x] Prepare private continuity, public-safe documentation and numbered TODOs.
[x] Verify Zanark through the existing PAT runner and create/link private Project.
[x] Mirror finite workstreams with persistent issue backlinks and verified statuses.
[x] Reconcile preparation evidence and persist the context milestone.

Acceptance criteria:
Verona is discoverable in Context Mesh with an owned continuity store.
No application stack, runtime, dependencies or camera use is assumed.
Contributor/workflow/book documents are navigable and truthful about their state.
Each finite workstream has exactly one issue and Project item with correct status.
Private continuity and credential files are Git-ignored.
No Git commit, push, release, deployment or background automation is performed.

Completion evidence:
Initial checkout contained only .git; existing origin is Zanark/Verona.
PAT runner returned login Zanark; repository is private and ADMIN-accessible.
Created private Project 15 and linked it to Verona; discovered actual Status IDs.
Mesh --check after adding the exact root discovered 42 contexts including Verona.
Three unique issue/Project mappings read back successfully; rerun required no
remote writes. vr-02 is closed/completed/Done; vr-03 remains open/Todo, blocked.
Four book inputs, Markdown file links and all eight workstream fields checked.
Owned context reconciles source review, remote tracking and preparation limits.
Cross-session milestone persisted as ep_1371; final checked mesh publication is
the session handoff gate, not application implementation or publication.

Completion log:
2026-11-18 - Owner requested preparation before supplying the product idea.
2026-11-18 - First mesh build succeeded but omitted Verona because its root was
not configured. Added only Verona's exact discovery root; next build found 42.
2026-11-18 - Initial import stopped on unsupported updateIssue stateReason;
used closeIssue instead and recovered via saved stable IDs without duplicates.
Immediate Project membership read missed the newly added third item; next fresh
inventory found the saved item and all three passed exact verification as no-ops.
2026-11-18 - Foundation authored and persisted. Product idea remains vr-03's
explicit blocker; no speculative implementation or book-rendering claim.
```

```text
ID: vr-05
Title: Research accurate speech-driven wireframe facial animation

Status: DONE
Milestone: Evidence-grounded technology recommendation before implementation.
Dependencies: None

Purpose:
Research recorded audio to a speaking connected face mesh, prioritizing accurate
articulation, timing and expression support over appearance. Preserve a future
streaming assistant path without building it during this research.

Tasks:
[x] Survey neural audio-to-geometry, phoneme/viseme and TTS-native timing paths.
[x] Trace shortlisted implementations, dependencies, licenses and representations.
[x] Verify actual local hardware constraints without installing or running models.
[x] Compare published evidence and identify incomparable/unverified quality claims.
[x] Define a bounded one-line prototype and accuracy/evaluation gates.
[x] Write sourced research, recommendation, open questions and book updates.
[x] Reconcile issue/Project tracking and private continuity.

Acceptance criteria:
Primary sources and pinned implementation references support consequential claims.
Recommendation distinguishes current-machine feasibility from quality aspirations.
Phoneme timing, coarticulation, geometry, synchronization and expressions are
treated separately. No promise of unique ground-truth facial motion from audio.
Code, weights, assets and dataset licensing are not conflated.
No application code/model inference, dependency installation, private audio
upload, camera/microphone activation, commit/push or deployment.

Completion evidence:
docs/chapters/04-speech-driven-face-research.md contains the five-lens research,
conditional shortlist, implementation traces, math/clock contracts and concrete
qualification corpus/gates. docs/research/speech-face-sources.md records pinned
primary sources across 12 repositories plus papers and official documentation.
book/manifest.json includes both authored sources. No model was executed.
Stable issue4 and its unique Project15item were read back with exact managed
body/state/status; issue3 now reflects the received idea and is In Progress.
Owned continuity records research findings and remaining compute/access choice.
Research completion is not implementation or accuracy acceptance.

Completion log:
2026-11-18 - Owner explicitly requested extensive deep research first and
emphasized accuracy. Initial scope excludes application implementation.
2026-11-18 - Source investigation found CUDA/TensorRT in the reviewed A2F runtime,
unimplemented regression inference in its Python runner, character rather than
phone-tier WhisperX alignment, and distinct rig/metric/license contracts.
Current inventory shows AMD Radeon780M and no listed NVIDIA GPU. Recommendations
remain conditional; CPU portability, real accuracy and latency are unmeasured.
2026-11-18 - Six manifest inputs, Markdown file links, citation receipts and
eight-field workstream structure checked. Initial new Project membership read
lagged; a fresh inventory found the saved item, with no duplicate creation.
Research deliverable complete; product definition continues under vr-03.
```

```text
ID: vr-06

Purpose:
Honor the owner's choice to keep everything free and local on the current AMD

regression network before accepting the larger UniTalker dependency/asset path.
This is a custom CPU experiment, not official SDK CPU support.

[x] Reconcile documentation, issue/Project tracking and private continuity.

No CUDA, paid service, remote inference, recording upload or device activation.
Model/runtime versions and asset hashes are explicit; no untrusted pickle load.
Finite, correctly shaped outputs are necessary but not a claim of accurate speech.
If the model cannot run here, report the exact blocker rather than faking motion.
No changes to global packages, sibling runtimes or other users' processes.

reproduction commands, measured results and explicit omissions.
```

```text
ID: vr-07
Title: Deliver a small free-local text-to-speaking-face prototype

Status: DONE
Milestone: Type a sentence and play synchronized local speech and connected face geometry.
Dependencies: vr-06

Purpose:
Deliver the owner's explicitly requested overnight prototype without cloud
inference, microphone/camera capture, global installs or interference with other
applications. Use the already-qualified Mark CPU network and installed Windows
speech voices rather than another large speech model.

Tasks:
[x] Inspect installed local speech voices and preserve the isolated CPU environment.
[x] Qualify matching native topology and decode complete real-speech motion clips.
[x] Implement bounded plain-text local speech synthesis and explicit expressions.
[x] Implement local-only text UI, connected face drawing and audio-clocked controls.
[x] Exercise actual generated speech, playback controls, failure and safety paths.
[x] Maintain the book, causal evidence, private continuity and issue/Project mirror.
[x] Commit and push coherent verified slices using the existing Zanark PAT runner.

Acceptance criteria:
The owner's "Hey, how are you?" input produces actual local speech and an
animated connected facial mesh in a window. No amplitude-only or letter-timed
fallback may pretend to be neural speech articulation. Playback, pause, restart
and seeking use the audio clock. Input and resource limits fail explicitly.
No new CUDA/PyTorch stack, cloud TTS, private upload, system policy change,
device capture or sibling process/profile modification. Model and mesh assets
stay ignored, pinned and verified. Separate functional verification from
unmeasured phonetic accuracy and absent human listening/visual acceptance.

Completion evidence:
Backend and interactive player implemented. Chapter 06 records
the actual greeting: David voice, 2.745s, 83 frames, 10,349-point reduced native
mesh and 5,153,802 motion bytes. Network median20.47ms/frame; motion generation
1.894s excluding synthesis/startup. Matching official topology and bounded
per-index rest differences verified; Maya scene is parsed as numbers, not run.
Twenty-five focused tests pass. Real Edge WebGL2 rendering, muted audio advance,
pause/resume/restart/end/seek, all three voices, four expression inputs, P/B/M,
F/V/vowel clips, overlong-speech rejection, injected failure/retry, empty input,
narrow layout and reload pass twelve browser scenarios. Final private receipt:
.local\qualification\browser-v3\browser-report.json; zero page exceptions/
external page requests; owned browser/server stopped and profile removed.
Screenshots inspected; speech has not been independently heard or human-accepted.
Player source af797df9ed83e9c88e69c0707d7e2548f48c7f4f committed/pushed and
exact remote main verified; twenty intended source/docs/test files, no models,
audio, private context or credential patterns. Author/committer Zanark, required
trailers and invocation-only PAT transport. Book and owned continuity updated.
Functional scope is complete; accuracy limitations above are not waived.

Completion log:
2026-11-18 - Owner authorizes autonomous overnight implementation, regular
commits/pushes and no questions. Local-only/free and shared-machine safety remain
mandatory. If genuinely blocked, persist detailed attempts and exact owner action.
2026-11-18 - Local text/speech/native-topology/complete-motion backend succeeds.
Fixed polygon continuation parsing before qualification; all source quads are
retained before edge-constrained reduction. Next: actual audio-clocked UI.
2026-11-18 - Implemented bounded loopback capability API, offline WebGL2 skin
renderer, local launch script and audio-clocked controls. Four-byte mesh index
alignment is explicit. Browser v1 corrected untrusted programmatic test clicks;
v2 corrected the harness's assumption about Edge's empty network errorText.
v3 passes twelve scenarios using trusted pointer input and actual blockedReason.
No autoplay/security bypass or additional dependency was introduced.
2026-11-18 - Published the verified player milestone af797df; exact remote ref
and clean tree read back. Reconciled product definition, book and continuity.
Closing this finite functional prototype does not close perceptual accuracy,
future recording/streaming or full SDK articulator work.
```
